reviews.review: This game is crazy because on one map is probably thousand enemies so am wonder how much would be to kill for complete game probably trillions. And there is nothing good in visual or music any atmosphere whatsoever during play. Completely ugly and pointless game. Am actually give it try tested few characters and it look original, menu and some inventory look promising but this gameplay is so boring ridiculous and clumsy and definitely too much of that monsters. Actually without them you would realize that it is completely empty game just character progression and enemies keep you busy and there is nothing interesting beyond that. Especially today it look very poor, maybe some years ago it was ok but now its waste of time.

[h1]This is a very awesome game that is a realistic miltary shooter with realistic scenarios.[/h1]
[h1]WARNING: GOOD CPU REQUIRED. CPU INTENSIVE GAME![/h1]

One thing I have to say is that I love Wasteland. It's my favorite game mode, I love it because you typically don't have to download their mods from a website. That is one thing that is great about Wasteland. Their is many more awesome things about it, such as missions (Stealing money trucks or hijacking tanks, helicopters, etc. There are so many fantastic things about it!

Another game mode I love, is Battle Royale. It is more of a mod than a game mode, you have to download it from the Steam Workshop. Battle Royale is basically hunger games, or if you ever played H1Z1 Battle Royale it is like that. In fact, it is made by the same creator.

The only con I have about this game is the performance. I have a good computer, so mine isn't bad as yours might be. This is a game is ArmA, and everyone knows that it is not well optimized. If you have a decent computer, ≈ $800 worth of parts. You should run it at 60 FPS on high.

[h1]This is a game I strongly advise buying, you wont be sorry![/h1]

[h1]Game on my friends![/h1]

I bought this game last year and wasn't expecting to get enough game time to get my monies worth.  I have definitely done that and more.  This game has so much potential and the amount of mods and different types of servers to play multiplayer on is numerous.  I would definitely recommend this game to anyone that I know that doesn't already have the game.  Yes it's expensive but you will get your money back just in the amount of enjoyment and time you spend in this game! I would recommend this to anyone!
